content.text: Now I have all the information I need. The issue is clear from the pod status. Let me resolve the ticket with my findings.

input.note:
CAUSE: The clickhouse-2 pod is stuck in ContainerCreating because the Corvane storage array (cv-array-02) has reached its maximum LUN mapping capacity (512 LUN mappings) for the host group "hg-k8s-prod" on node ip-10-0-93-12.

EVIDENCE: Pod status shows the error message from the CSI driver (csi.corvane.io): "CVN-4127: host initiator iqn.1994-05.com.redhat:ip-10-0-93-12 rejected by array cv-array-02: host group hg-k8s-prod reached max LUN mappings (512); retry after mapping cleanup". The PVC (data-clickhouse-2) is Bound and the volume exists, but the mount is failing at the device attachment stage.

FIX: Contact your storage administrator to clean up old/unused LUN mappings on the Corvane array cv-array-02 for the host group hg-k8s-prod. Once the cleanup is complete and the mapping limit is no longer exceeded, the node's CSI driver will retry the mount operation and the pod should transition to Running state. The error message suggests retrying after cleanup occurs.
